I really really liked the second game blood money. The art style was so freaky yet so cool. It was such a cool concept for a game, like clicker gone bad. I really liked the voice actor, they fit really well into the role and conveyed such awesome emotion. The third game (Vigil) is very, very cool. The fact that it tracks your blinking is such a cool concept for a game. And having those big robot workers move every time you blink, amazing. Jacks screams during that game were amazing and I was DYING during the “sausage” part. All and all, I have absolutely no experience with game making so I have no right to critique these people you all did such a good job on these games.
